task: VowAsia B-beta adversarial self-check by the executor (NOT the G22 reviewer verdict)

scenarios.scenario: Agent or tool runs --apply against production by accident
scenarios.rationale: non-local DATABASE_URL needs --confirm-host equal to the host and a TTY for --apply; database name must be exactly /neondb (dry-run too); the name is printed first. Tests: import-vowasia-main.test.ts 'Central guards'.

scenarios.scenario: Wrong database on the same Neon server (gcv_payload_disabled)
scenarios.rationale: assertCentralDbName refuses; tested with a fake host and that name.

scenarios.scenario: Media stored on the Mac disk instead of R2
scenarios.rationale: r2Preflight refuses --apply on a non-local Central unless the 4 R2 vars are non-empty; created Media prefix must equal vowasia.

scenarios.scenario: Rollback of run B deletes rows of run A, or a row adopted from another run
scenarios.rationale: importer never adopts (marker rows are skipped, unjournaled marker rows refuse --apply); rollback deletes only its own journal rows; dangling intents need all 5 conditions incl. (c) id not in any other run. Scenario tests 1-3 + rehearsal rollback B then A.
O_EXCL lock for every --apply mode; stale lock blocks rollback until removed by the runbook steps (tested + rehearsed).

scenarios.scenario: Private snapshot content written into the PUBLIC repo
scenarios.rationale: assertOutsideRepo on --runs-dir, --snapshot, --out and the answer file directory (git-ignored in-repo dirs refused); dry-run writes only <runs-dir>/dry-<ts>.

scenarios.scenario: HTML/script injection through legacy body text
scenarios.rationale: body.en becomes Lexical text nodes only (no HTML parsing); test asserts literal <script> stays text and node types are heading/paragraph/text/upload.

scenarios.scenario: Old image host survives in a body, or a pending upload node is stored
scenarios.rationale: planner rejects rows with an image-host URL in text; buildLexical throws without a Media id; post-check before create; verify re-checks.

scenarios.scenario: timestamps-fix.sql touches rows of another run or tenant
scenarios.rationale: each block requires a.id = <journaled id of this run> + marker + tenant subselect; integer id check; golden-file test.

scenarios.scenario: rewrite-links rewrites to a row another run may roll back, or touches external links
scenarios.rationale: target must be in this run's slug map AND live published; external links never in the replacement map; tests 6-9.

scenarios.scenario: Secret printed (DB URL, password, R2 values)
scenarios.rationale: tools print only host:port/db and R2 variable NAMES; errors pass through the phase-A redact. A Payload/driver error text could still carry unknown sensitive detail; not exhaustively provable by tests (reviewer to judge).
